facts.statement: During the Summer Sizzle promotion, several summer items were offered at reduced prices under Item of the Day, each discounted for a single day only.
facts.quote: Vous les trouverez sous Objet du Jour! Mais dépêchez vous, car ils seront seulement offerts à un prix réduit pour une seule journée!

facts.statement: A daily 'Item of the Day' feature was promoted on August 18, 2011, but the item itself is not shown in the captured text.
facts.quote: Here's a peek at the Item of the Day for Free Realms ®.

article_summaries.title: Super Fan Summer Sizzle- 12 août 2011
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post announcing the Super Fan Summer Sizzle promotion, running Friday 12 August to Thursday 18 August 2011. It gives a 30% discount on Station Cash purchases with exclusions, plus one-day discounts on summer items under Item of the Day. It also mentions featured items at the Marketplace for participating games, without naming them.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short SOE 'Daily Special' news post dated August 18, 2011. It says the Super Fan Summer Sizzle promotion ends that day, with discounted Station Cash available online, and teases an Item of the Day, but the captured text does not name the item or give its details.
